parsed.reason: The message does several things right. It sticks to the one place the parent named and substitutes no other gyms. The empty pick list is acceptable, since the notes are empty and no page was read. It makes no unearned negative claim, and it explicitly says not finding a class is not the same as there being none. Because watch is true, the first-person 'I'll keep watching and text you' is correct. It is plain text with no link and no question. However, the rubric asks an empty-result message to say plainly what was looked at. 'The sources I checked' is vague: it never says whether Cartwheel Gym's own site was tried. Under no_page_read, the honest specific line would be something like 'I could not get into Cartwheel Gym's page today'. Honest but not specific, so it falls short of a 5.
